name: Universal Logistics - Memphis Terminal - Memphis TN

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 4014 Outland Rd, Memphis, TN 38118 via the loadmatch.com intermodal directory (Universal Intermodal Services, Inc. / Memphis, TN, companyID 2565). The same address appears across third-party directories branded 'Mason Dixon Intermodal' (phone 901-546-9273) — Mason Dixon is a Universal/ULH operating brand; some listings show 'Universal Intermodal Svc' at the identical address. The loadmatch profile describes a 58-acre container-yard depot handling APL/Evergreen and other private container pools, with top-lift handlers, private 20'/40' chassis, and ~35 drivers. Street View confirms stacked Evergreen ocean containers in the yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View along Outland Rd (2025-04 / 2025-11) shows the yard frontage is tree-screened with the container yard directly behind. The truck entrance is a wide open gravel/paved apron meeting Outland Rd near the north end of the yard — NO barrier arm, NO sliding/swing gate across the truck lane visible. The yard's road edge is largely open dirt apron rather than a continuous controlled gate line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the entrance or anywhere on the property in satellite or Street View. Only equipment-shop / small office buildings are present in the yard interior.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate (open uncontrolled entrance), so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: NONE — this is a drayage/intermodal container yard, not a cross-dock. The buildings in the yard are equipment shops / a small office with no rhythm of loading-dock doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Banded 50+. Satellite (2026) shows the yard densely loaded with stacked ocean containers (multiple colors), long rows of chassis, and parked trailers — a large working container/chassis storage yard. Street View confirms stacked Evergreen containers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The yard is a very large open gravel lot; ample depth between Outland Rd and the yard interior for 3+ trucks to queue without spilling onto the road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The Outland Rd frontage and entrance apron are very wide with substantial unused width — physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Three small structures in the yard interior — an equipment/maintenance shop, a smaller shop/canopy, and a small office building. No large warehouse.
fieldNotes.railServed: false — no rail spur runs into this parcel. It is a truck drayage container yard in the Lamar Ave / Outland Rd intermodal corridor that interchanges with Memphis-area rail ramps (BNSF/NS/CN/UP); rail does not enter the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~21.5 acres computed from the perimeter box for the ACTIVE container yard. The loadmatch directory claims a 58-acre yard — that larger figure likely includes the adjoining vacant grass field south of the active yard and/or additional Universal-controlled land. Geofenced to the active yard; the 58-acre directory claim is noted as a discrepancy.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~60 trailers/chassis estimated from 2026 satellite — low confidence, the yard is densely and irregularly loaded with containers and chassis.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~350 — the yard is a very large open gravel lot capable of holding a large number of trailers/chassis/containers; honest estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Memphis metro industrial fabric (38118, Lamar Ave / Outland Rd intermodal corridor near the airport) — Urban.
